After breakfast the family is in a hurry.
Then Henrik and Emma walk to the bus together.
sentences.Henrik skal på jobben. Emma skal på skol: Henrik is going to work. Emma is going to school.
In her bag she has books and a packed lunch.
Marianne is in a hurry too.
Then she washes Jonas and gets him dressed.
sentences.Marianne kjører Jonas til barnehagen, og: Marianne drives Jonas to nursery, and then she drives to work.
